title: Waiter Robot
description: Features Bluetooth-based app summoning and ultrasonic navigation. It includes a custom GUI tablet for order processing, a servo-actuated dynamic serving tray, an automated beverage dispenser, and communication via an SV17F voice module.

title: Chef Robot
description: Utilizes IR sensors for line tracking and an ultrasonic sensor to detect the waiter. It features servo-driven arms for automated ingredient pouring and an entertaining “Salt Bae” seasoning motion.

title: Smart Stove
description: An autonomous prop that detects the chef via an ultrasonic sensor to trigger synchronized theatrical effects. It simulates realistic fire using programmable RGB LEDs, fans, and fabric, combined with relay-driven ignition sparks and a cold mist maker for steam simulation.
